answer: Put a velvet rope at the gate of admission: a newcomer enters only if a sponsor locks a bond for it, and it gains voting weight only after a voyage of several epochs under random spot audits seeded by a public beacon. When an audit exposes a fake, the slash climbs the vouching chain: the sponsor loses its bond and each sponsor above it loses a decreasing share. A garden of n clones needs n separate bonds, n voyages and n audit survivals, and one exposed clone puts every ancestor bond at risk, so attacker cost grows faster than gain.
